newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Westell initiated at hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Westell initiated at hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Friday initiated coverage of Westell Technologies Inc with a hold recommendation.

-- But analyst Charles Pluckhahn is withholding recommending the purchase of any Assymetric Digital Subscriber Line (ADSL) technology developers until there is more evidence that market acceptance and technology development milestones have been met.

-- Pluckhahn said Westell's Carrierless Amplitude Phase modulation (CAP) technology has been a pioneer in the development of ADSL, although it is subject to glaring weaknesses. These include a lack of standardization with other recognized standards, such as Discrete Multitone modulation, Pluckhahn said.
-- Pluckhahn added that the coming year should be crucial for CAP, and a definitive rejection of the technology would be a major blow to Westell.
-- Westell develops high-speed Internet transmission products based on ADSL technology.
